51030849.protein: Nuclear receptor subfamily 4 group A member 1
51030849.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to Nur77 (unknown origin) by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The SPR experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) at 25 °C. The Nur77 LBD (residues 140–300) was immobilized on a CM5 sensor chip via amine coupling. The ligands were dissolved in running buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% P20) and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM. The association phase lasted 120 s, followed by a 120 s dissociation phase. The sensor surface was regenerated with 10 mM glycine-HCl, pH 2.0. Data were analyzed using Biacore Evaluation Software 2.0. The binding affinity (KD) was calculated from the association (ka) and dissociation (kd) rate constants using the equation KD = kd/ka.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% P20
